'''Cirtappa''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Alui sector/Legends|Alui sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] attacked an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] convoy near Cirtappa. It was one of the first missions of [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] after he joined the Rebellion.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' {{1stm}}
